advice.Moderate: Sensitive groups should limit prolonged outdoor exertion.
advice.Hazardous: Avoid all outdoor activity. Stay indoors with windows closed.

advice.Good: UV levels are low. Sunscreen is optional for short exposure.
advice.Moderate: Wear sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses during midday sun.
advice.Poor: Apply SPF 50+, wear protective clothing, and seek shade around midday.
advice.Hazardous: Avoid direct sun exposure. Stay indoors or in deep shade between 10am and 3pm.

advice.Good: Temperature is comfortable for most outdoor activity.
advice.Moderate: Carry water and take shade breaks during the warmest part of the day.
advice.Poor: Limit strenuous outdoor activity and check on children, older people, and pets.
advice.Hazardous: Avoid outdoor exertion. Stay in air-conditioning or a cool place and hydrate frequently.

advice.Good: Humidity is comfortable for most people.
advice.Moderate: Take regular breaks, drink water, and watch for early signs of heat stress.
advice.Poor: Reduce strenuous activity and stay in shaded or ventilated areas.
advice.Hazardous: Avoid prolonged outdoor activity. Move to a cool, dry place and monitor for heat illness.

advice.Good: Rainfall is light and conditions are generally manageable.
advice.Moderate: Carry rain protection and allow extra travel time on wet roads.
advice.Poor: Avoid unnecessary travel during heavy showers and watch for localised flooding.
advice.Hazardous: Stay off flooded roads and seek shelter away from creeks, drains, and low-lying areas.
